北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，体感很凉，多穿点，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it feels chilly. Bundle up and stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪风力 3级，体感微凉，出门记得添衣哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is breezy. It feels cool, remember to add layers when you go out.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海天气晴朗，风力不大，早晚温差大，注意添衣。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny with little wind. Mind the temperature difference and dress warmly.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，风力 3级，体感略凉，别忘了带伞哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy with moderate wind. It feels a bit cool, don't forget your umbrella.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳天气阴，微风舒适，记得随身携带外套以防着凉。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy with a light breeze. Keep a jacket handy to avoid catching a cold.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗干燥，注意补水，早晚温差大要保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and dry. Stay hydrated, and keep warm as the temperature varies.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京风力 3级，体感略低，出门记得多穿点哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is breezy and feels a bit cold. Remember to wear more layers when you go out.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，温和舒适，但早晚凉，别忘带件外套。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and mild. It's cool in the mornings and evenings, so bring a jacket.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴朗，气温适宜，早晚注意添衣别着凉哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny with pleasant temperatures. Remember to add layers morning and evening.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗干燥，气温低，多喝水，注意防寒保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and dry with low temperatures. Drink more water and stay warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，湿度高，体感舒适，但别忘了带伞哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy with high humidity. It feels comfortable, but don't forget your umbrella.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨风力 4级，体感极寒，一定要多穿暖和！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin has strong winds and feels extremely cold. Please dress very warmly!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳气温很低，风力不大，保暖工作要做好哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is very cold with light wind. Make sure to dress warmly.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，气温舒适，风力 3级，注意防晒哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant, with moderate wind. Remember to protect yourself from the sun.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门风力 4级，体感较凉，出门带件外套别着凉。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has strong winds and feels cool. Bring a jacket when you go out to avoid catching a cold.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 0℃，风力 3级，出门防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like 0℃ with moderate wind. Dress warmly against the wind.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感-2℃，天气寒冷，注意防寒保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels like -2℃. It's cold, so stay warm.
